v2.label: v2 · v1 + one retest re-entry (re-arm after a wrong stop-out).

v13.label: v13 · v2 + RUNWAY GATE (no new entry after 14:00) — leaves time to reach target before the close.

v14.label: v14 · v2 + STRICT runway gate (13:00) — the highest win rate of the family; built for OPTIONS, where win rate beats R-multiple.

scoring_note.pure: Signal-pure backtest: no brokerage or slippage, no entry cutoff, and trades still open at 15:30 are excluded. Optimistic — use for ranking models, not for sizing money.
scoring_note.honest: 0.04% costs, 14:30 entry cutoff, open trades marked to the 15:30 close, one-candle pivot-confirmation lag; on options a further 2% of premium for brokerage, STT and one tick of spread. The tradeable number.
